model.notes: Dropped the two proposed crowd-shift skip rules: p_random was 0.77 and 0.34, and the matched entries were actually positive, so a fast swing short is not a squeeze signal by itself. The two take rules refine the near-miss proposal (shift <= -0.18 / 4h <= 5 / lev <= 10, p = 0.07). They swap the 4h condition for crowd-level confirmation, which separates the profitable JCT/MAGMA/EVAA rejects from the ESPORTS squeezes. Leverage is capped at 10 so they do not collide with the accepted skip rule for 10x+ shorts with Bybit at or below 0.36 and a non-falling 1h. The long-side skips rest on few cases but have a clear mechanism; their thresholds are kept broad.
